**Finding submitted — deviation (NONCOMPETE).**

- **Responsive clauses:** § 12.4 (p0046) is the only Customer non-compete in the document (confirmed by searches for "competes", "non-compete", "restrict", "exclusive"; no cross-references to 12.4 exist). § 12.3 (p0044) affirms the opposite.
- **Why it fails:** term plus 24 months post-term, undefined scope ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), any territory, and it bars acquisitions and internal development — walk-away on duration and scope, and it fails all five fallback elements.
- **Cure (preferred):** single surgical replace flipping the prohibitory operator and deleting the 24-month tail, leaving the remainder of the sentence verbatim, so Customer carries no non-compete or field-of-use restriction and § 12.3 is no longer contradicted. Fallback narrowing offered in the comment.
